global.garment_shape_lock: GARMENT SHAPE & LENGTH — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The garment's silhouette, length, and construction must match the product reference exactly. Apply the rule for whichever garment type is shown: tops and t-shirts must NOT be shortened into a crop top or cropped tee; shirts and blouses must retain collar, cuffs, and hemline unchanged; jackets and blazers must retain lapels, length, and structure — do NOT shorten or lengthen; dresses and skirts must keep the hemline at the exact same point — a midi stays midi, ankle-length stays ankle-length; outerwear (coats, hoodies) must retain length, hood shape, and structure; caps and hats must retain brim shape, crown height, and style exactly; footwear must retain silhouette, sole height, and style — sneakers stay sneakers, heels stay heels, sandals stay sandals. The pose reference person may wear a different garment — take ONLY their body stance, never their garment shape, length, or silhouette.
global.print_lock_angle: PRINT/PATTERN — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The product reference images may show multiple views (front, back, etc.). Each print or graphic is FIXED to a specific side — do NOT transfer a print from the back onto the front or vice versa. Reproduce ONLY the print naturally visible from this angle of the garment. Do NOT rescale, simplify, alter, or replace the print.
global.footwear_block: Do NOT copy or reproduce footwear from any reference image — ignore the shoes on the model in reference image 1 and ignore any footwear visible in the product reference images. Default to simple nude pointed-toe heels unless a different footwear is specified in the global instruction. Apply the same footwear consistently across every shot in this set.

garment_orientation.Front: GARMENT ORIENTATION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The FRONT of the garment must face the camera. Model faces forward directly toward the camera. Do NOT show the back of the garment.
garment_orientation.Styled: GARMENT ORIENTATION: By default the FRONT of the garment must be visible. EXCEPTION: Only show the BACK of the garment if the shot instruction or global instruction explicitly requests a back-styled shot.
garment_orientation.Side: GARMENT ORIENTATION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: Show only the SIDE PROFILE of the garment — neither the full front nor the full back. Model faces to the right.
garment_orientation.Back: GARMENT ORIENTATION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The BACK of the garment must face the camera. Model faces completely away from the camera.

e_shared.lighting: LIGHTING: Lighting intensity, color temperature, and overall brightness must be identical to every other shot in this set — no shot should appear brighter, darker, warmer, or cooler than the others. The model must look naturally lit within the scene, not composited onto it.
e_shared.shadow: SHADOW: The model must cast a natural shadow consistent with the ambient light — this anchors her physically in the space.
e_shared.bgLock: BACKGROUND COLOR — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The wall color and floor color from the background reference image must appear EXACTLY as shown — same hue, same saturation, same brightness. Do NOT recolor, relight, warm, cool, or shift the background in any way based on the model's pose or angle. The background is a FIXED CONSTANT. Only the lighting on the model adapts to the background — never the other way around.
e_shared.framingLock: FRAMING IS NON-NEGOTIABLE: The camera distance and model scale defined for this shot type must not change based on the background. Do NOT zoom out or pull the camera back to show more of the environment. The background must fit within the model's required framing — not the other way around.

e_styled.garment_absolute_lock: GARMENT — ABSOLUTE LOCK: Reproduce the garment from the product reference images EXACTLY. Do NOT alter: color, shade, silhouette, neckline, straps, waist details (belt/tie/bow/elastic), skirt construction, hemline height, or any construction detail.
e_styled.garment_accessories: Do NOT add any belt, tie, or waist accessory that is not on the product garment. Do NOT remove any belt, tie, or waist detail that IS on the product garment. The pose reference person wears a different outfit — ignore that outfit entirely. Use ONLY the product reference images for the garment.
e_styled.framing: FULL BODY — entire figure visible. FRAMING: The model should occupy at least 65% of the frame height — medium to medium-wide shot.
e_styled.garment_fidelity: GARMENT FIDELITY — CRITICAL: The garment must be reproduced EXACTLY from the product reference images — same color, same print, same pattern, same construction. Do NOT change the garment color, print scale, print density, motifs, embellishments, hemline, neckline, or silhouette in any way. The pose reference image contains a person wearing a different garment — ignore that garment completely and reproduce ONLY the product garment from the product reference images.
e_styled.print_lock: PRINT/PATTERN — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The product reference images show multiple views of the garment (front, back, etc.). Each print or graphic is FIXED to a specific side of the garment — front prints stay on the front, back prints stay on the back. Do NOT transfer or mirror a graphic from the back onto the front or vice versa. For this front-facing shot, reproduce ONLY the print or graphic that is naturally visible from the front of the garment. If the back has a different or more prominent print, it must NOT appear in this shot. Do NOT rescale, simplify, alter, or replace the print. Do NOT add borders, embroidery, or embellishments that are not present in the product reference.
e_styled.pose_action_with_pose: Action: REPLICATE THE EXACT POSE from the pose reference image — same body stance, arm position, weight distribution, and body language. This is NON-NEGOTIABLE. Do NOT default to a plain standing pose or invent a different pose.
e_styled.pose_action_without_pose: Action: editorial lifestyle pose — creative, natural, and expressive. The model should look candid and editorial, not stiff. Mood: aspirational fashion campaign.
e_styled.scene_integration: SCENE INTEGRATION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The model must look physically present in the scene, not composited onto it. Her feet must cast a natural ground shadow onto the floor surface consistent with the ambient light. Edge transitions between the model and background must be photorealistic — no sharp cutout edges.

e_detail_closeup.action: Action: ZOOM INTO THE ACTUAL GARMENT on the model. Any skin, hair, or partial face visible in this tight crop MUST belong to the exact same person from reference image 1 — do NOT generate a different person's face, neck, or body for this close-up.
e_detail_closeup.body: Do NOT reimagine, reconstruct, add, or exaggerate any garment detail. Do not over-emphasize seams or stitching beyond what is visible in the reference. lighting_presets.name: Studio — Soft Diffused
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Soft, even, diffused studio lighting with no strong directional source. Consistent brightness and color temperature across the entire figure. No harsh shadows. The model must look naturally and evenly lit from all sides within a studio environment.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A soft, subtle shadow falls directly below the model's feet onto the studio floor — close to the body, minimal spread, no strong directional cast. This gently anchors the model to the ground.

lighting_presets.name: Natural Ambient
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Natural indoor ambient light — soft, slightly warm, with no dominant single light source. Light wraps gently around the model from multiple directions as it would in a well-lit interior space. The model must look naturally lit within the scene, as if physically standing in the room.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A soft, diffused shadow falls below and slightly behind the model's feet, consistent with gentle ambient lighting from above. No harsh edges — the shadow blends naturally into the floor surface and anchors the model to the ground.

lighting_presets.name: Golden Hour — Warm, Left
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Warm golden hour light coming from the left side of the scene. Warm orange-amber color temperature, creating a soft glow on the left side of the model and gentle warm shadows on the right. The overall image should feel warm and cinematic.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A warm-toned shadow falls to the right of the model's feet, consistent with a warm light source on the left. The shadow is elongated and soft-edged, following the floor surface naturally.

lighting_presets.name: Cool Daylight — Overcast
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Cool, soft overcast daylight — as if shooting on a cloudy day or near a large north-facing window. Even, slightly cool color temperature with no strong directional source. Flattering and clean with soft gradients rather than hard shadows.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A minimal, very soft shadow falls directly below the model's feet. Due to overcast light the shadow has very soft edges and low contrast — subtle but present to anchor the model to the surface.

lighting_presets.name: Dramatic Side Light
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Strong, dramatic directional light from the left side. Bold contrast between the lit left side of the model and the shadowed right side. Slightly warm-neutral color temperature. Creates a high-fashion, editorial mood.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A strong, defined shadow falls to the right of the model's feet, consistent with a dominant light source from the left. The shadow has visible edges and extends noticeably to the right across the floor surface.

lighting_presets.name: Soft Window Light
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Soft, gentle light from a window on the left side of the scene. Natural, slightly warm color temperature. Creates a gentle gradation from lit (left) to slightly shadowed (right) on the model. Feels intimate and natural — not harsh or dramatic.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A soft, feathered shadow falls gently to the right of the model's feet, consistent with soft window light from the left. The shadow has a gradual, diffused edge that fades into the floor surface naturally.
